columnHelp.team: Team he played most minutes for in this scope.
columnHelp.league: League he played most minutes in.
columnHelp.pos: Position he played most minutes in: GK, DF, MF or FW (FBref match sheets).
columnHelp.age_end: Age on 30 June 2024, the end of the data.
columnHelp.minutes: Minutes played in the same matches as the goals.
columnHelp.involvements: Goals he was involved in as scorer, SCA1 or SCA2, one credit per goal.
columnHelp.assists: Involvements as SCA1 (the action right before the shot) without scoring.
columnHelp.pre_assists: Involvements as SCA2 (the action before that) only.
columnHelp.ep: Expected points from his involvements, each at the goal's time-aware value.
columnHelp.ep_lo: Lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval of ep.
columnHelp.ep_hi: Upper end of the 95% bootstrap interval of ep.
columnHelp.p90_lo: Lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval of p90.
columnHelp.p90_hi: Upper end of the 95% bootstrap interval of p90.
columnHelp.theta: EP per 90 pulled toward the average for his position, by more when his minutes are few.
columnHelp.theta_lo: Lower end of the 95% posterior interval of theta.
columnHelp.theta_hi: Upper end of the 95% posterior interval of theta.
columnHelp.pull_pct: How much of the gap to the position average the shrinkage removed (%).
columnHelp.rank: Rank by theta among players with 900+ minutes.
columnHelp.rank_lo: Best plausible rank (2.5th percentile of the posterior rank).
columnHelp.p_top10_pct: Chance (%) that his true rate is in the top 10.
columnHelp.team_share_pct: His EP as a share (%) of his team's goal value while he played (minutes as exposure).
columnHelp.p90_roles: EP per 90 under the old rule: every role a credit, so a self-assisted goal counts twice.
columnHelp.p90_weighted: EP per 90 with the goal split 40 / 35 / 25 between scorer, SCA1 and SCA2.
columnHelp.theta_season: The season's EP per 90 pulled toward the position average.
columnHelp.ga: Goals plus SCA1 assists in the season (one per goal).
columnHelp.eligible: Players with 900+ minutes in this league-season.
columnHelp.award: The award used for this league.
columnHelp.winner_rank: Where the winner ranks on the model's list (blank: goalkeeper or under the minutes floor).
columnHelp.ga_leader: Player with the most goals + assists in the league-season.
columnHelp.source: Where the award winner is documented.
columnHelp.ep_sca2_lo: Lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval of ep_sca2.
columnHelp.ep_sca2_hi: Upper end of the 95% bootstrap interval of ep_sca2.
columnHelp.share_sca2_pct: SCA2 share (%) of his EP with roles counted separately.
columnHelp.ep_per_inv: EP per involvement: the average value of the goals he was involved in.
columnHelp.lo: Lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval.
columnHelp.hi: Upper end of the 95% bootstrap interval.
columnHelp.time_blind: The same with time-blind goal values (scoreline only).

datasetHelp.Players: One row per player over 2017-18 to 2023-24, top 5 leagues, at least 450 minutes. A goal credits its scorer, SCA1 and SCA2 once per player, at the goal's time-aware value from Project 02. theta is the rate pulled toward the position average (empirical Bayes); rank, rank_lo and rank_hi only for players with 900+ minutes.
datasetHelp.Player-seasons: One row per player, league and season (450+ minutes). theta_season is the season's rate pulled toward the position average; it decides the model's pick in the award check.
datasetHelp.Award check: The model's pick per league-season (highest theta_season, 900+ minutes) next to the actual award winner and the goals + assists leader. Sources link to the award pages.
datasetHelp.SCA2 (pre-assists): Roles counted separately: every SCA2 credit counts, even when the same player also scored or assisted. ep_sca2_lo / hi: 95% bootstrap interval. Players with 10+ SCA2 credits.
datasetHelp.Decisive goals: EP per involvement: the average value of the goals a player was involved in. Players with 50+ involvements. lo / hi: 95% bootstrap interval.
